ContactSection.subtitle: We are here to make your visit unforgettable. Visit us in the countryside or drop us a message.

tradicion.title: Ancestral Heritage
tradicion.text: Our connection to the land goes back generations. We honor Andean tradition not only in the kitchen, but in the deep respect for natural cycles and our culture's ways of life.

sistema.title: Agroecological Cycle
sistema.text: We are not just a restaurant, we are an ecosystem. Kitchen waste feeds the soil, the soil nourishes our crops, and our crops sustain our animals in a perfect cycle of sustainability.

manejo.title: Transparency & Handling
manejo.text: Our animals, like guinea pigs and pigs, are raised in wide spaces, with natural feeding and strict welfare standards. We believe dish quality starts with respect and care on the farm.

Hospedaje.title: The Refuge
Hospedaje.subtitle: Lodging in the heart of Quingeo
Hospedaje.description: Our cozy rooms and suites are designed to disconnect from the urban routine. A peaceful environment surrounded by nature, fresh air, and the authentic Andean landscape of the Azuay countryside.
Hospedaje.roomsDesc: Cozy spaces with private bathrooms and spectacular views of the mountain or the garden.
Hospedaje.roomDoubleDesc: Ideal for couples, equipped with a double bed and garden views.
Hospedaje.roomTripleDesc: Perfect for small families, with guaranteed space and comfort.
Hospedaje.roomSuiteDesc: Our premium option with a private terrace, fireplace, and panoramic views.
Hospedaje.bookingText: Take a break in your journey with us. Contact us directly via WhatsApp to check availability and make your reservation.
